meta.name: cobrapy
meta.description: Constraint-based metabolic modeling (COBRA). FBA, FVA, gene knockouts, flux sampling, SBML models, for systems biology and metabolic engineering analysis.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析代谢网络模型，模拟基因敲除与通量分布
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在做代谢网络建模或代谢工程分析
copy.tagline_en: Analyze metabolic network models, simulate gene knockouts and flux distributions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are working on constraint-based metabolic modeling or metabolic engineering analysis

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以加载、编辑和运行代谢模型，执行通量平衡分析（FBA）、通量可变性分析（FVA）、基因敲除模拟、通量采样等计算，并输出生长速率、代谢物通量等结果。
howto.when: 当用户要求分析代谢模型、预测生长或敲除基因效果，或需要计算代谢通量分布时触发。

say.text: 加载大肠杆菌核心模型并运行FBA。
say.note: Claude会加载模型并输出生长速率。

say.text: 对模型iJO1366做单基因敲除筛选。
say.note: Claude会执行所有基因的单敲除并返回生长结果。

say.text: 计算模型在厌氧条件下的最小培养基。
say.note: Claude会修改培养基并计算最小营养需求。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can load, edit, and run metabolic models, perform FBA, FVA, gene knockout simulations, flux sampling, and output growth rates and metabolite fluxes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to analyze metabolic models, predict growth, simulate knockouts, or compute flux distributions.

say_en.text: Load the E. coli core model and run FBA.
say_en.note: Claude loads the model and outputs growth rate.

say_en.text: Perform single gene deletion screen on iJO1366.
say_en.note: Claude runs all single knockouts and returns growth results.

say_en.text: Compute minimal medium under anaerobic conditions.
say_en.note: Claude modifies medium and calculates minimal nutrient requirements.
